description: Implementation of the MPSGuardImpl class in the ATen/MPS framework, managing Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) events and synchronization.

classes.name: MPSGuardImpl
classes.description: Class responsible for creating, recording, querying, waiting, and synchronizing MPS events.

methods.name: createEvent
methods.description: Creates a new MPS event (empty implementation).

methods.name: destroyEvent
methods.description: Destroys an MPS event and releases it from the event pool.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Records an MPS event on a given stream.

methods.name: block
methods.description: Blocks until the specified event is completed.

methods.name: queryEvent
methods.description: Queries whether an event has completed.

methods.name: synchronizeEvent
methods.description: Synchronizes (waits for) an event to complete.

methods.name: elapsedTime
methods.description: Calculates the elapsed time between two events.

methods.name: synchronizeDevice
methods.description: Synchronizes the default MPS device stream.
